abstract: Paracardial cystic lesions (PCLs) are rare, benign lesions and may occur in any part surrounding the heart. It covers a variety of pathological types, including pericardial cysts, thymic cysts, bronchogenic cysts and so on. The aim of this study was to summarize the diagnostic value of echocardiography in different pathological types of the PCLs. Echocardiographic features of 43 consecutive PCL patients treated at the Union Hospital from January 2002 to December 2017 were compared and analyzed with their surgical and pathological findings retrospectively. The PCLs included 19 pericardial cysts, 12 thymic cysts, 7 bronchogenic cysts, 3 cystic teratomas, 1 enteric cyst and 1 lymphangioma. Among them, 29 cases (67.4%) were accurately diagnosed by echocardiography and 14 cases (32.6%) were missed the diagnosis. All diagnosed cysts were showed as thin-walled, monolocular, echo-free structures without blood flow signals in echocardiographic images. 4 patients had compression of the heart and great vessels caused by cysts. In addition, 4 intracardiac lesions were diagnosed by echocardiography and the results were further confirmed in surgery. Echocardiography is of great value in the diagnosis of paracardiac cystic lesions as well as combined intracardiac lesions. Differential diagnosis could be mainly made based on the location of the lesions.
abstract_ja: 心臓周囲嚢胞性病変(PCL)は、稀で良性の病変であり、心臓を取り囲むあらゆる部位に生じうる。心膜嚢胞、胸腺嚢胞、気管支原性嚢胞などを含む様々な病理型を包含する。本研究の目的は、PCLの異なる病理型における心エコー検査の診断的価値をまとめることであった。2002年1月から2017年12月までに同病院で治療された、連続したPCL患者43例の心エコー所見を、手術所見および病理所見と後方視的に比較・解析した。PCLの内訳は、心膜嚢胞19例、胸腺嚢胞12例、気管支原性嚢胞7例、嚢胞性奇形腫3例、腸性嚢胞1例、リンパ管腫1例であった。このうち29例(67.4%)は心エコー検査で正確に診断され、14例(32.6%)は診断を見逃された。診断された嚢胞はすべて、心エコー画像で血流信号のない、薄壁で単房性の無エコー構造として示された。4例では、嚢胞による心臓および大血管の圧迫がみられた。さらに、心エコー検査で4例の心臓内病変が診断され、その結果は手術で確認された。心エコー検査は、心臓周囲嚢胞性病変および合併する心臓内病変の診断において高い価値を有する。鑑別診断は、主に病変の部位に基づいて行うことができる。
